# General questions

- First, students can ask themselves if their cognitive labour is being affected by an artifact; and if ‘yes’ then they can ask what that relationship means for their specific context. (Guest, Suarez et al.) 
- Is this simulation actually equivalent to the labour, the learning or the care it replaces? (Ray and Guest) 
- whose labour gets replaced? (less relevant for students)
- Do I learn what I am supposed to learn?
